enter.heading: On the Machine, run
enter.body: Then scan the QR code it shows, or paste its link here.
enter.noCamera: Veeloe can't use the camera here. Paste the link instead.

confirm.heading: Pair with this Machine?
confirm.body: It will trust this device's key and run what you send through this Hub. Only continue if you started veeloe pair yourself.

pairing.heading: Pairing…
pairing.body: Keep veeloe pair running on the Machine until this finishes.
